name: Florence Finance
rootCause: Florence Finance lost $1.45 million USDC on Ethereum due to an address poisoning attack on November 28, 2023. The attacker crafted a scam address almost identical to the intended recipient, tricking Florence's operators into transferring funds to the fake account. Confirmed on-chain evidence establishes the loss and subsequent laundering steps. The Florence Finance team relied on wallet transaction history and visual similarity when selecting recipient addresses for a large USDC transfer, failing to verify the entire address.
